##### Project general facts

Candace Acacia is a sophisticated residential development that combines elegance and convenience, offering a choice of studios and one-bedroom apartments designed with a focus on sophistication and functionality. Each unit exudes a modern and stylish ambiance, providing residents with a comfortable and inviting living space that is thoughtfully crafted to create a harmonious and aesthetically pleasing environment. Whether a cozy studio or a spacious one-bedroom apartment, every detail is carefully curated to offer a modern and fulfilling living experience.

The development offers residents a sophisticated and convenient lifestyle with convenient amenities and proximity to various services. The thoughtfully designed community ensures that every lifestyle need is catered to, creating a harmonious blend of comfort, elegance, and practicality. Residents can enjoy a modern living experience in a well-appointed environment that promotes well-being and convenience.

Each residence features high-quality materials and premium appliances and bathroom fittings, creating living spaces that exude contemporary elegance and functionality. The stylish interiors are designed to provide maximum comfort and convenience, ensuring effortless everyday living. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a welcoming and sophisticated atmosphere that residents are proud to call home.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Al Furjan, a modern and vibrant residential community that offers a high standard of living and a range of amenities for its residents. The community is conveniently located near major highways such as Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro, providing easy access to other parts of the city. The area's strategic positioning near the Jebel Ali Free Zone and the Dubai Expo site makes it an ideal choice for professionals and families alike.

The community is designed to provide a comfortable and luxurious lifestyle, with a range of amenities including parks, community centers, swimming pools, and sports courts. One of the unique features of the area is its emphasis on green spaces, with parks and landscaped areas spread throughout the community. Residents can enjoy a tranquil environment that promotes well-being and outdoor recreation.

The neighborhood offers convenient access to retail outlets and restaurants located within the community, providing residents with easy access to shopping and dining options. The well-planned infrastructure ensures that everything needed for daily life is close at hand. This distinguished location represents the perfect balance of modern convenience, green living, and community connectivity, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most desirable residential communities.
